about: PCore's catalogue: the parts, the shapes of each part, the scales and what each style picks first. The style only puts its choices first: every shape and scale stays open to every style. Steps: one character per grid step (x note, X accent, o soft, . rest, - the note before goes on; in bass shapes K is where the kick plays: a rest on the bass track, B a bass note, b a soft one). Contract: docs/contracts/core-pcore.md. Status: hypothesis until Diogo has heard them.

scales.name: Harmonic minor

scales.name: Phrygian

scales.name: Locrian

scales.name: Minor pentatonic

scales.name: Chromatic

parts.name: Bass
parts.about: The bass: it plays in the gaps the kick leaves (the K in KBBB)

parts.name: Build / Fill
parts.about: Rolls and fills before a drop or a new part

parts.name: Lead / Pluck
parts.about: The main line: leads, plucks, acid lines

parts.name: Arp
parts.about: The notes of a chord played one after the other

parts.name: FX
parts.about: Zaps, lasers, stabs: short and wild

shapes.name: Four on the floor
shapes.about: One kick on every beat: the base of every psy style

shapes.name: Four, last beat off
shapes.about: Every 4 bars the last kick drops out: the track breathes before the next phrase

shapes.name: Four + ghost on the last 16th
shapes.about: A soft extra kick pushes into the next bar (hi-tech, darkpsycore)

shapes.name: Double at the end of the phrase
shapes.about: Kicks on the off-beats in the 4th bar: a fill made with the kick

shapes.name: Half time
shapes.about: Two kicks per bar: feels half as fast (slambient, very high BPM)

shapes.name: Kick roll every 8 bars
shapes.about: Seven plain bars, then the kick rolls into the next part

shapes.name: Down: into the break
shapes.about: What the track plays now (the KBBB already there, or KBBB when empty) keeps going, then slows down into the break and ends on one kick

shapes.name: Down up: slow to full speed
shapes.about: Starts with slow kicks (boom... boom) and speeds up step by step until it plays with the rest at full KBBB

shapes.name: Down up down: slow, fast, slow
shapes.about: Slow kicks that speed up into fast KBBB, then slow down again into one kick

shapes.name: Intro: full speed, then break
shapes.about: Two bars of full-speed KBBB in 8 bars (about 2 seconds at 210 BPM), then a few chaotic seconds that fall apart into one kick, before the real intro

shapes.name: KBBB moving
shapes.about: The rolling KBBB, but each beat can take another note of the scale and comes back to the key: the hi-tech and psycore roll

shapes.name: KBBB (rolling)
shapes.about: Three bass notes after every kick: the rolling psy bass

shapes.name: KBBB, octave on the last
shapes.about: The last note of every beat jumps an octave up: bouncier

shapes.name: KBBB with an answer
shapes.about: Bar 2 ends on another note: question and answer over two bars

shapes.name: KBB_
shapes.about: Two notes and a gap: tighter, more air (darkpsy, twilight)

shapes.name: K_BB
shapes.about: A gap after the kick, then two notes: punchy and late

shapes.name: KB_B
shapes.about: Note, gap, note: a broken roll

shapes.name: K_B_ (offbeat)
shapes.about: One bass note between the kicks: progressive and old-school

shapes.name: KBBBBB (triplet roll)
shapes.about: Five fast notes per beat in triplets: the hi-tech gallop

shapes.name: KBB (triplet)
shapes.about: Two notes per beat in triplets: swinging, hi-tech and darkpsycore

shapes.name: KBBBBBBB (1/32)
shapes.about: Machine-gun bass at 1/32: darkpsycore and hi-tech at slower BPM

shapes.name: KBBBBB moving (triplet)
shapes.about: The hi-tech gallop with notes that change from beat to beat along the scale

shapes.name: KBBBBBBB moving (1/32)
shapes.about: Machine-gun bass at 1/32 whose notes move along the scale every beat: darkpsycore

shapes.name: KB (half time)
shapes.about: KBBB at half speed: for 300+ BPM (slambient)

shapes.name: Long notes
shapes.about: Held bass notes that move slowly: breaks and ambient parts

shapes.name: 8ths

shapes.name: Gallop

shapes.name: Sparse

shapes.name: Ride on the beats
shapes.about: A ride on every beat: shine on top

shapes.name: Ride on the offbeat

shapes.name: Crash every 4 bars

shapes.name: Crash every 8 bars

shapes.name: Clap on 2 and 4
shapes.about: A clap on beats 2 and 4

shapes.name: Sparse snare

shapes.name: Rims on the 16ths
shapes.about: Small hits between the hats: darkpsy texture

shapes.name: Broken

shapes.name: Triplet stabs

shapes.name: Roll + silence

shapes.name: Smooth roll
shapes.about: Speeds up all the way, from 1/4 to 1/64

shapes.name: Fast roll
shapes.about: Starts already fast (1/16) and ends in a buzz: hi-tech, darkpsycore

shapes.name: Snare stairs

shapes.name: One-bar fill
shapes.about: A short fill at the end of a bar: between two phrases

shapes.name: Call and answer
shapes.about: The same short phrase three times, then a different end

shapes.name: Acid line
shapes.about: Busy 16ths that move a step or two at a time

shapes.name: Hypnotic
shapes.about: Few notes in threes over and over: progressive, twilight

shapes.name: Wide plucks
shapes.about: Plucks that jump far up and down: chaotic hi-tech

aligns.name: Full-on rolling
aligns.about: Kick and bass take turns, never together (KBBB). Bass notes short and even, the first after the kick a little softer (80 / 100 / 100). Hats straight, softer on the kick, offbeat hat on top.

aligns.name: Progressive offbeat
aligns.about: Room after each kick: no bass on the 1/16 right after it (K_B_ / K_BB feel), longer bass notes. Hats a touch late and lightly swung, offbeat hat clearly on top.

aligns.name: Darkpsy tight
aligns.about: Tight KBBB: shorter bass notes with clear gaps, the kick always alone. Hats straight and busy, only a little softer on the kick.

aligns.name: Psycore machine
aligns.about: Machine-tight: very short bass notes, the smallest gap before each kick, hats exactly on the grid with almost no accent.

aligns.name: Hi-tech galloping
aligns.about: Very short bass and hat notes on their own grid (triplets stay triplets), a hair early for urgency, no swing.

aligns.name: Slambient space
aligns.about: Long bass notes that only stop before the kick, sparse hats laid back and swung for space.

aligns.name: Twilight groove
aligns.about: Groovy KBBB: medium bass notes, hats a touch late with a little swing.

styles.name: Full-on

styles.name: Darkpsy

styles.name: Dark psycore

styles.name: Hi-tech

styles.name: Slambient

styles.name: Twilight
styles.about: Dark but groovy: tight bass, Eastern colour
